# Website animation dependencies

These unmodified browser distributions are served by Nemo itself; visitors do not
contact a library CDN. They are separate from Nemo's MIT-licensed code.

- GSAP 3.13.0 — `gsap.min.js`, from https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/gsap@3.13.0/dist/gsap.min.js
- ScrollTrigger 3.13.0 — `ScrollTrigger.min.js`, from https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/gsap@3.13.0/dist/ScrollTrigger.min.js
- Upstream: https://github.com/greensock/GSAP/tree/3.13.0
- Licence: https://gsap.com/standard-license/

Copyright 2025 GreenSock. Original copyright and licence headers remain in both
files. Consult the GSAP Standard License for permitted use and redistribution.
No other GSAP plugins are bundled.
